item.title: What mattered in AI yesterday — 2026-07-15
item.description: What mattered in AI yesterday — 2026-07-15 OpenAI releases GPT-5.6 family: Luna, Terra, Sol OpenAI unveiled three new models — Luna, Terra, and Sol — priced per 1M input/output tokens as $1/$6, $2.50/$15, and $5/$30 respectively. They bring improved reasoning and tool use, competing directly with Claude Opus and others. The tiered pricing lets engineers match model size to task complexity, which is a practical shift for production deployments. Simon Willison’s Blog Hermes: The naming is poetic, but the real story is the pricing ladder — finally a clear signal for cost-conscious scaling.
